label: Guitar string
summary: A shorter string vibrates faster, so the note is higher.
steps: Pressing a fret shortens the string. Half the length gives double the frequency: f = v / 2L.
A string also vibrates in whole-number patterns: harmonics n = 1, 2, 3 at f, 2f, 3f.
Wave speed depends on tension T and mass per length: f = (1/2L) sqrt(T/mu). Tighter = higher.
